prose: Apple said it will add controls around Full Disk Access on macOS, because AI agents raise the risks of that level of access. The feature exists so backups work. The announcement came days after a journalist claimed Meta's Muse app on Mac read private messages, which Meta disputed.
highlights: New controls for macOS Full Disk Access.
Apple says AI agents increase the risk.
Follows a disputed claim about Meta's Muse app reading messages.
